title: DeliveryIssuePage
description: One page of `GET /delivery/v1/issues?project=...&openOnly=true&cursor=...&limit=...`, the listing Factory's Phase 2 poll reads (all open issues in the enabled projects; selection and qualification stay in Factory). Consumer rule: an issue's ABSENCE from a listing proves nothing (not resolved, not deleted) unless the scan's final page has `complete: true` AND every page's `unavailableProjects` was empty.

nextCursor.description: Opaque; pass back as `cursor` for the next page. `null` on the last page. Pages are ordered by (`created`, `issue.vendorId`), so an issue created mid-scan appears in this or a later scan and is never silently skipped by a page boundary.

complete.description: `true` only on the last page of a scan that read every requested project fully. `false` on intermediate pages and on any page where the service stopped early.

openOnly.description: Open = the state's vendor `isResolved` is false.

unavailableProjects.description: Requested projects that could not be listed. Non-empty makes the scan incomplete regardless of `complete`.
